pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies_comment: node-pty ships prebuilt binaries for macOS and Windows only, so on Linux it compiles pty.node at install time. pnpm >= 10 skips a dependency's build scripts unless it is listed here, and install still exits 0 — the failure only surfaces later as 'Failed to load native module: pty.node'. node-gyp is a devDependency because pnpm, unlike npm, does not supply one: node-pty's install script calls bare `node-gyp`, which otherwise resolves to whatever the machine happens to have (nothing on many, or a years-old distro build that produces a pty.node that segfaults).
pnpm.auditConfig_comment: GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm (braces, stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns) has no fix: 3.0.3 is the latest release, and micromatch 4 still depends on it — including under http-proxy-middleware 4, so there is nothing to upgrade to. It is also unreachable here: neither createProxyMiddleware call in server/proxy.ts passes a pathFilter, so micromatch never compiles a pattern, and no user input reaches one. Re-check when braces publishes a fix.
pnpm.comment: Version-scoped overrides bump only the vulnerable major of transitive deps to a patched release, leaving other resolved majors (e.g. path-to-regexp@0.1.x, used by other tooling) untouched.
